note: Adoptable cats: famous real, fictional and viral cats with no sanctuary coin yet. Fan tributes, not affiliated with their owners. Built by scripts/build-adoptables.mjs; checked by assets/ui/adoptables.js.

cats.name: Meredith Grey
cats.story: Meredith Grey is Taylor Swift's Scottish Fold, adopted in late 2011 and named after the Grey's Anatomy lead. She appeared in Swift's Diet Coke and Keds ads and is famous for her aloof, 'sassy' posture. People reported her rare 2025 appearance after Swift bought back her masters.
cats.look: Scottish Fold: small folded ears, round face; pale grey/silver-white coat with soft grey shading on the head, back and tail; large round amber-copper eyes; no accessories.

proof.author: people
proof.text: Taylor Swift's Cat Meredith Makes Rare Appearance After Star Regains Control of Her Masters — and Fans React

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Taylor Swift.

cats.name: Benjamin Button
cats.story: Benjamin Button is Taylor Swift's Ragdoll, introduced in her 2019 'ME!' video and draped over her shoulders on TIME's 2023 Person of the Year cover. Swift joked on X: 'Can I bring my cat.'
cats.look: Ragdoll: medium-long silky coat, cream-white body with seal/brown-grey colorpoint on the face mask, ears and tail, faint pointed legs; vivid blue eyes; no collar.

proof.author: taylorswift13
proof.text: Time Magazine: We’d like to name you Person of the Yea- Me: Can I bring my cat.

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Taylor Swift.

cats.name: Larry
cats.story: Larry, a brown-and-white tabby from Battersea, has been Chief Mouser to the Cabinet Office at 10 Downing Street since February 2011, outlasting several Prime Ministers; CBS reported him awaiting his seventh PM in 2026.
cats.look: Brown tabby-and-white: white chest, belly and paws, brown mackerel tabby back and head; green-yellow eyes.

proof.author: Number10cat
proof.text: 15 years ago today I arrived on Downing Street in a cage. I've seen off Cameron, May, Johnson, Truss and Sunak and I'm still going strong. Only two Prime Ministers have ever done longer stints here: William Pitt the Younger and Sir Robert Walpole. Bill and Bob - I'm coming for you... (Photos AP)

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by UK Cabinet Office (10 Downing Street).

cats.name: Choupette
cats.story: Choupette is the blue-cream Birman of fashion designer Karl Lagerfeld, who called her 'the center of the world'. She had two maids, travelled by private jet, starred in campaigns (Shu Uemura, Hublot) and was named among his heirs. The Atlantic and Telegraph covered her life after his 2019 death.
cats.look: Birman: long silky white-cream coat, blue-cream points on face, ears and tail, white 'gloved' paws; deep sapphire-blue eyes; often shown on luxury cushions.

proof.author: TheAtlantic
proof.text: The late Karl Lagerfeld’s blue-cream Birman cat lived a pampered life with two maids, chef-prepared meals served on the best china, and travel by way of private jet. Chris Heath explores the delightfully absurd life of Choupette:

sources.label: Remembering the Perfect Partnership Between Karl Lagerfeld and His Cat, Choupette | Vanity Fair

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Karl Lagerfeld (estate).

cats.name: Maru
cats.story: Maru, a Scottish Fold from Japan, rose to fame in 2008 diving into cardboard boxes; Guinness recognised him in 2016 as YouTube's most-viewed animal. He died in September 2025 aged 18.
cats.look: Scottish Straight (upright ears): cream-white and grey-brown tabby, chubby round body; golden eyes; inside a cardboard box.

proof.author: GWR
proof.text: Maru the cat, who broke record by squishing himself into tiny cardboard boxes, dies at 18

sources.label: Maru the cat, who broke record by squishing himself into tiny cardboard boxes, dies at 18 | Guinness World Records
Video: Meet Maru ‘Mugumogu’ - the cardboard box-loving, record-breaking cat | Guinness World Records

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by mugumogu (Japan).

cats.name: Bob
cats.story: Bob was a ginger stray who adopted busker James Bowen in London in 2007; their story became the bestseller A Street Cat Named Bob and two films in which Bob played himself. He died in 2020; a bronze statue stands in Islington.
cats.look: Ginger (orange) tabby with white-tipped muzzle hints, often wearing a scarf and perched on shoulders; green eyes.

proof.author: artukdotorg
proof.text: A statue commemorating Bob, the feline companion of James Bowen and star of the series 'A Street Cat Named Bob' was unveiled last week 🐈 'Street Cat Bob' by Tanya Russell (b.1975) and James Bowen (b.1979) © the copyright holders 📸 Nick Hodgson / Art UK

sources.label: A Street Cat Named Bob (film) - Wikipedia

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by James Bowen.

cats.name: Meowth
cats.story: Meowth is the Scratch Cat Pokémon (#052); the Team Rocket Meowth who taught himself to talk and walk upright has been a main anime character since 1997. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company regularly feature the Jessie-James-Meowth trio.
cats.look: Cream cartoon cat with a gold koban coin charm on the forehead, brown-tipped paws and tail curl.

proof.author: NintendoAmerica
proof.text: The famous Team Rocket trio of Jessie, James, and Meowth along with their Poison-type Pokémon Ekans and Koffing will be sure to cause trouble during your adventure in the #PokemonLetsGo games. Will they have the skills to back up their trash talk?

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Pokémon (Nintendo/Game Freak/Creatures).

cats.name: Lil BUB
cats.story: Lil BUB (2011–2019) was the 'magical space cat' with dwarfism, extra toes and a permanently protruding tongue, cared for by Mike Bridavsky; she raised over $700,000 for pets and starred in Lil Bub & Friendz (2013).
cats.look: Small grey-brown tabby with white chest, tiny face, big green eyes, tongue always sticking out, short legs.

proof.author: IAMLILBUB
proof.text: It's me, Mike - BUB's dude. BUB has departed, she's on her way home. -

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Mike Bridavsky.
cats.sensitivity: In loving memory of Lil BUB.

cats.name: Pusheen
cats.story: Pusheen is the chubby grey tabby cartoon cat created by Claire Belton and Andrew Duff in 2010, based on Belton's cat; famous for GIFs and stickers.
cats.look: Chubby grey cartoon tabby with darker stripes on head and back, tiny paws.

cats.name: Kitty Purry
cats.story: Kitty Purry was a pregnant stray who crawled through a window to Katy Perry's then-boyfriend around 2005; she became Perry's grey tabby, appeared in the 'I Kissed a Girl' (2008) video and lent her name to the fan club. Perry tweeted 'KITTY PURRY IS A CAT'; she died in April 2020, aged about 15.
cats.look: Silver-grey classic tabby with darker grey stripes, white muzzle hints; green eyes; ordinary domestic shorthair.

proof.author: katyperry
proof.text: IT'S OKAY HELLO KITTY FANS, KITTY PURRY IS A CAT.

sources.label: Katy Perry mourns the death of her beloved pet cat, Kitty Purry - ABC News
Katy Perry mourns the death of her beloved cat Kitty Purry - Billboard

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Katy Perry.
cats.sensitivity: In loving memory of Kitty Purry.

cats.name: Delilah
cats.story: Delilah was Freddie Mercury's favourite of his many cats at Garden Lodge, London. He wrote the Queen song 'Delilah' (Innuendo, 1991) about her, and Sotheby's featured his cats in its 2023 Mercury auction.
cats.look: Tortoiseshell-and-white (calico) domestic cat: white chest and paws, patches of black and ginger on back and head; green-gold eyes.

proof.text: Freddie Mercury's love for his cats over the years was legendary. The cats of Garden Lodge—Mercury’s home in London—each had their own distinct personality. Meet Mercury's feline family as #TheWorldofFreddieMercury takes over #SothebysLondon this week:

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Freddie Mercury.

cats.name: Leo (Lisa's cat)
cats.story: Leo is the Scottish Fold cat of BLACKPINK's Lisa (Lalisa Manoban), often called 'the owl' by fans; he appears in her Instagram and has his own fan following. Media such as Koreaboo and Clout News have featured Lisa's photos with Leo.
cats.look: Scottish Fold (born 9 Feb 2018): tiny folded ears, round owl-like face; grey/silver tabby-and-white coat; large round amber eyes.

cats.name: Willow
cats.story: Willow is a grey tabby farm cat who jumped on stage during Jill Biden's 2020 campaign speech in Pennsylvania. She moved into the White House in January 2022 as First Cat, named after Willow Grove, PA.
cats.look: Grey tabby with dark stripes, white-grey muzzle, green eyes; short hair.

proof.author: Reuters
proof.text: 🐱 The Biden family finally has a cat. First lady Jill Biden's office has announced America's first family is excited to welcome a two-year-old, gray-and-white-striped feline named Willow to the White House 1/4

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Jill & Joe Biden (First Family).

cats.name: Gli
cats.story: Gli (2004–2020) was the tabby born at Hagia Sophia who lived there for 16 years; Barack Obama petted her on a 2009 visit. Reuters covered her fame; she died in November 2020 and was buried on the grounds.
cats.look: Tabby-and-white Turkish shorthair with striking green eyes set slightly crossed; white chest and paws.

proof.author: reuterspictures
proof.text: Gli the cat, with thousands of Instagram followers and even Barack Obama as a fan, can stay as Istanbul's Hagia Sophia turns from a museum into a mosque, authorities said. Read more: 📷 @MuradSezer

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Hagia Sophia, Istanbul.

cats.name: Tombili
cats.story: Tombili was a chubby Istanbul street cat famous for lounging against a step with one paw draped; after her 2016 death a bronze statue of her pose was placed in Kadıköy, stolen and recovered.
cats.look: Chubby white-and-grey tabby with grey tabby patches on head and back; lounging pose.

proof.author: volcaholic1
proof.text: In Istanbul, Turkey, a statue was built to honour Tombili, the city’s beloved stray cat, in her famous lounging pose. The statue was stolen just weeks after its 2016 unveiling but later recovered, repaired, and returned to its original spot, where it still rests today.

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Kadıköy, Istanbul.

cats.name: Stepan
cats.story: Stepan is the Kharkiv cat whose deadpan poses with wine glasses made him an Instagram star; after Russia's 2022 invasion he fled with his owner and raised funds for Ukrainian animals, and won a World Influencers and Bloggers Award.
cats.look: Brown/grey tabby British-type cat with round face, white chest; yellow-green eyes; seated upright.

proof.author: Ukraine
proof.text: Rollin into the weekend like Stepan the cat from Kharkiv, Ukraine🍷🐱 ig: loveyoustepan

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anna (Kharkiv).

cats.name: Jorts
cats.story: Jorts is the orange workplace cat from a viral 2021 Reddit AITA post in which a coworker wanted to 'help' him by greasing him with butter; he and tortie Jean became internet icons (@JortsTheCat).
cats.look: Big orange (ginger) tabby with white chest, sweet dim expression; amber eyes.

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Jean (anonymous office worker).

cats.name: Tama
cats.story: Tama, a calico stray, was made stationmaster of unstaffed Kishi Station in 2007; tourism boosted the struggling Kishigawa Line. She was promoted to 'super stationmaster' and VP, and after her 2015 death was enshrined as 'Honourable Eternal Stationmaster'.
cats.look: Calico: white body with orange and black patches; amber-green eyes; wears a small navy stationmaster cap with gold badge.

proof.author: qikipedia
proof.text: From 2007 to 2015, Tama the cat rose from stationmaster at the unmanned Kishi station in Japan, to ‘super stationmaster’, to Vice President of the railway, and, after her death, to ‘Honourable Eternal Stationmaster’ and a Shinto goddess. (Image: Sanpei)

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Wakayama Electric Railway (Kishi Station).

cats.name: Jonesy
cats.story: Jones ('Jonesy') is the Nostromo's ginger ship's cat in Ridley Scott's Alien (1979), rescued by Ripley and the only other survivor; he returns in Aliens (1986). NECA and Dead by Daylight made official Jonesy items.
cats.look: Ginger (orange) tabby with white chest, medium coat; amber eyes; often in a small pet carrier.

proof.author: NECA_TOYS
proof.text: The ALIEN 40th Anniversary Collection Ripley includes some all new accessories: the Motion Detector, Cat Carrier, and a new Jonesy. Also includes the flamethrower & digital printed face deco. #facehuggerfriday

cats.tribute: Fan tribute, not affiliated with or endorsed by Alien (20th Century Studios / Disney).

cats.name: Crookshanks
cats.story: Crookshanks is Hermione Granger's half-Kneazle cat, bought in Diagon Alley in 1993, who sensed that Ron's rat Scabbers was really Peter Pettigrew. Wizarding World Japan's official account featured him.
